commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<empty>}"; echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<empty>}"; echo "SESSION=${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-<empty>}"; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch 2>/dev/null || echo "no config-get vendored"
echo "=== growth ==="; scripts/prompt-surface-growth.py 2>&1; echo "=== deferrals ==="; ls -la .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1744/deferrals.json 2>&1; echo "=== workpad ==="; scripts/workpad.py id 1734 2>&1
for sub in claim mark-running finish; do echo "=== $sub ==="; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/verification-flight.py $sub --help 2>&1; done

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1734/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true); echo "trigger=$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"; if [ -n "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction hooray --r …[per-command-truncated]

rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/implement-active-1734" || true; rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1734.md" || true; echo "markers cleared"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
